data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'balanos', meaning 'strong, powerful, or warrior'. In the New Testament, Balch is the name of a Roman centurion who had great faith. The name Balch carries the meaning “Strong, powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Balch usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
